Title: Azure Firewall Premium now generally available in five new Azure regions

Body.Content:
Azure Firewall Premium is now generally available in the following new Azure Cloud regions:

  • USGov Texas
  • USGov Arizona
  • USGov Virginia
  • China North 2
  • China East 2

Azure Firewall Premium provides next generation firewall capabilities that are required for highly sensitive and regulated environments.

For more information, see the Azure Firewall Premium documentation.
